title: ELECTRONIC CIRCUIT DESIGN I
description: Analyze and design analog electronic circuits, including device characteristics of diodes, MOSFETs, and bipolar junction transistors; transistor amplifier circuits and biasing techniques; small- and large-signal circuit characteristics; and, design of linear circuits.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: ECE 202 or ENGR 202.
A minimum grade of C is required in ECE 202 and ENGR 202.
meeting_html: M 10am-11:50am in DEAR 222 - Dearborn Hall 222 (9/23 to 12/4)
